products.name: MacBook Pro 14-inch M3 Pro
products.description: The MacBook Pro 14-inch with M3 Pro chip delivers exceptional performance for professional workflows. With up to 18 hours of battery life, a stunning Liquid Retina XDR display, and advanced thermal design, it handles demanding tasks like video editing, 3D rendering, and software development with ease.
products.shortDescription: 14-inch MacBook Pro with M3 Pro chip, 18GB RAM, 512GB SSD.

specifications.ports: 3x Thunderbolt 4, HDMI, SD card slot, MagSafe 3

products.name: ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11
products.description: The ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 is an ultra-lightweight business laptop with enterprise-grade security features. Powered by 13th Gen Intel Core processors, it offers exceptional keyboard comfort, a brilliant 2.8K OLED display option, and all-day battery life for mobile professionals.
products.shortDescription: 14-inch ultralight business laptop with Intel Core i7, 16GB RAM.

products.name: Dell XPS 15 9530
products.description: The Dell XPS 15 9530 combines stunning design with powerful performance. Featuring a 15.6-inch InfinityEdge display, 13th Gen Intel Core processors, and NVIDIA GeForce RTX graphics, it's perfect for developers and creators who need a balance of portability and power.
products.shortDescription: 15.6-inch premium laptop with Intel i7, RTX 4050, OLED display.

products.name: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14
products.description: The ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 packs incredible gaming and creative performance into an ultra-portable 14-inch form factor. With AMD Ryzen 9 and NVIDIA RTX graphics, a 165Hz display, and the iconic AniMe Matrix LED lid, it's built for gamers and creators on the move.
products.shortDescription: 14-inch gaming laptop with Ryzen 9, RTX 4060, 165Hz display.

products.name: HP Spectre x360 14
products.description: The HP Spectre x360 14 is a versatile 2-in-1 convertible laptop with a stunning OLED touchscreen. It features 13th Gen Intel Core processors, a 360-degree hinge for tablet mode, and premium build quality with gem-cut accents.
products.shortDescription: 14-inch 2-in-1 convertible with Intel i7, OLED touchscreen.

products.name: LG UltraGear 27GP950-B
products.description: The LG UltraGear 27GP950-B is a 27-inch 4K Nano IPS gaming monitor with a 160Hz refresh rate and 1ms response time. It covers 98% of DCI-P3 color space and supports HDMI 2.1, making it ideal for both gaming and color-accurate creative work.
products.shortDescription: 27-inch 4K 160Hz Nano IPS gaming monitor with HDMI 2.1.

specifications.adaptiveSync: NVIDIA G-Sync Compatible, AMD FreeSync Premium Pro

products.name: Samsung Odyssey G7 32-inch
products.description: The Samsung Odyssey G7 features a 32-inch 1440p curved VA panel with a blazing 240Hz refresh rate and 1ms response time. Its 1000R curvature provides an immersive gaming experience, while the QLED technology delivers vivid colors.
products.shortDescription: 32-inch 1440p 240Hz curved QLED gaming monitor.

specifications.adaptiveSync: NVIDIA G-Sync, AMD FreeSync Premium Pro

products.name: Dell UltraSharp U2723QE
products.description: The Dell UltraSharp U2723QE is a 27-inch 4K USB-C Hub monitor designed for professionals. It features IPS Black technology for deeper blacks, 100% sRGB and 98% DCI-P3 coverage, and a built-in KVM switch for seamless multi-device workflows.
products.shortDescription: 27-inch 4K USB-C Hub monitor with IPS Black, KVM switch.

specifications.ports: USB-C 90W PD, HDMI, DP, RJ45, USB Hub

products.name: ASUS ProArt PA278QV
products.description: The ASUS ProArt PA278QV is a 27-inch WQHD monitor designed for creative professionals on a budget. It offers accurate colors with 100% sRGB and Rec. 709 coverage, factory-calibrated accuracy, and a ergonomic stand for comfortable long sessions.
products.shortDescription: 27-inch WQHD ProArt monitor with factory-calibrated colors.

products.name: LG 34WN80C-B UltraWide
products.description: The LG 34WN80C-B is a 34-inch UltraWide WQHD monitor perfect for multitasking and coding. With a 21:9 aspect ratio, USB-C connectivity with 60W power delivery, and On-Screen Control software, it boosts productivity for developers and professionals.
products.shortDescription: 34-inch UltraWide WQHD monitor with USB-C 60W PD.

products.name: Keychron Q1 Pro
products.description: The Keychron Q1 Pro is a wireless custom mechanical keyboard with a full aluminum body, hot-swappable switches, and QMK/VIA support. It offers Bluetooth and wired connectivity, south-facing RGB, and a premium typing experience for developers and enthusiasts.
products.shortDescription: 75% wireless custom mechanical keyboard with aluminum body.

products.name: Logitech MX Keys S
products.description: The Logitech MX Keys S is an advanced wireless keyboard designed for professionals. With perfect stroke keys, smart illumination, Easy-Switch between devices, and multi-computer control via Logi Flow, it's the ultimate productivity keyboard.
products.shortDescription: Advanced wireless keyboard with smart backlighting and multi-device.

specifications.battery: Up to 10 days with backlight, 5 months without

products.name: Corsair K100 RGB
products.description: The Corsair K100 RGB is a premium mechanical gaming keyboard with OPX optical switches, a programmable iCUE control wheel, and per-key RGB lighting. Its 4000Hz polling rate and dedicated macro keys make it the top choice for gamers and power users.
products.shortDescription: Premium mechanical keyboard with iCUE control wheel, 4000Hz polling.

products.name: Royal Kludge RK84
products.description: The Royal Kludge RK84 is an affordable 75% wireless mechanical keyboard that punches above its price. With triple-mode connectivity, hot-swappable sockets, and impressive RGB, it's the best budget entry point into custom mechanical keyboards.
products.shortDescription: Budget 75% wireless mechanical keyboard, hot-swappable.

products.name: Leopold FC660M PD
products.description: The Leopold FC660M PD is a compact 66-key mechanical keyboard revered by typing enthusiasts. With premium PBT double-shot keycaps, a solid steel plate, and Cherry MX switches, it delivers an unmatched typing feel in a space-saving layout.
products.shortDescription: 66-key compact mechanical keyboard with Cherry MX switches.

products.name: Logitech MX Master 3S
products.description: The Logitech MX Master 3S is the flagship ergonomic mouse for professionals. With an 8000 DPI sensor, quiet clicks, MagSpeed scroll wheel, and Logi Flow cross-computer control, it's the gold standard for productivity mice used by developers worldwide.
products.shortDescription: Ergonomic wireless mouse with 8000 DPI, MagSpeed scroll, USB-C.

products.name: Razer DeathAdder V3
products.description: The Razer DeathAdder V3 is an ultra-lightweight ergonomic gaming mouse weighing just 59g. Featuring the Focus Pro 30K optical sensor and Gen-3 optical switches, it delivers precision and speed for competitive gaming and fast-paced work.
products.shortDescription: Ultra-lightweight 59g ergonomic mouse with 30K DPI sensor.

products.name: Logitech G Pro X Superlight 2
products.description: The Logitech G Pro X Superlight 2 is the lightest esports mouse from Logitech at just 60g. With the HERO 2 sensor, LIGHTFORCE hybrid switches, and 95-hour battery, it's the weapon of choice for professional gamers and fast-click demanding tasks.
products.shortDescription: 60g wireless esports mouse with HERO 2 sensor, 95-hour battery.

products.name: Razer Viper V3 HyperSpeed
products.description: The Razer Viper V3 HyperSpeed is a lightweight wireless gaming mouse with a symmetrical design. Featuring the Focus Pro 30K sensor, Gen-3 optical switches, and up to 230 hours of battery life, it offers exceptional value for competitive gamers.
products.shortDescription: Lightweight wireless mouse with 30K sensor, 230-hour battery.

products.name: Sony WH-1000XM5
products.description: The Sony WH-1000XM5 are industry-leading noise-cancelling headphones with Auto NC Optimizer, 30-hour battery life, and LDAC support. Their lightweight design and premium comfort make them ideal for focused coding sessions, calls, and travel.
products.shortDescription: Premium ANC headphones with 30-hour battery, LDAC, multi-point.

specifications.noiseCancellation: Industry-leading ANC with Auto NC Optimizer

products.name: Apple AirPods Pro 2
products.description: The Apple AirPods Pro 2 with USB-C feature the H2 chip for computational audio, up to 2x more noise cancellation than the previous generation, and a personalized Spatial Audio experience. Perfect for seamless Apple ecosystem integration.
products.shortDescription: ANC earbuds with H2 chip, USB-C, Adaptive Transparency.

specifications.battery: Up to 6 hours (30 hours with case)

products.name: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones
products.description: The Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones deliver the best noise cancellation from Bose with Immersive Audio support. Featuring CustomTune sound calibration, a 24-hour battery life, and luxurious comfort, they redefine premium audio.
products.shortDescription: Premium ANC headphones with Immersive Audio, CustomTune.

products.name: HyperX Cloud III Wireless
products.description: The HyperX Cloud III Wireless gaming headset delivers immersive DTS Headphone:X audio with 53mm drivers, up to 120 hours of wireless battery life, and signature HyperX comfort. It's built for marathon gaming and streaming sessions.
products.shortDescription: Wireless gaming headset with DTS, 53mm drivers, 120-hour battery.

products.name: Sennheiser Momentum 4 Wireless
products.description: The Sennheiser Momentum 4 Wireless headphones offer audiophile-grade sound quality with Adaptive Noise Cancellation and a remarkable 60-hour battery life. Their minimalist design and premium build make them perfect for discerning listeners.
products.shortDescription: Audiophile ANC headphones with 60-hour battery, adaptive ANC.

products.name: Logitech Brio 4K Ultra HD
products.description: The Logitech Brio 4K Ultra HD webcam delivers cinematic video quality with 4K recording, HDR, and a noise-cancelling dual microphone. It's the premium choice for video calls, streaming, and content creation.
products.shortDescription: 4K Ultra HD webcam with HDR, noise-cancelling mic, Windows Hello.

products.name: Elgato Facecam Pro
products.description: The Elgato Facecam Pro is the world's first 4K60 webcam. With a Sony STARVIS sensor, uncompressed 4K video at 60fps, and advanced color controls via Elgato Camera Hub, it's built for streamers and content creators who demand the best.
products.shortDescription: 4K60 webcam with Sony STARVIS sensor, uncompressed video.

products.name: Razer Kiyo Pro Ultra
products.description: The Razer Kiyo Pro Ultra features a large Sony STARVIS 2 sensor for exceptional low-light performance. With 4K 30fps or 1080p 60fps, HDR support, and an adaptive light sensor, it delivers studio-quality video in any lighting condition.
products.shortDescription: 4K webcam with Sony STARVIS 2, adaptive light sensor, HDR.

products.name: Anker PowerConf C200

products.shortDescription: Budget 2K webcam with AI noise cancellation, privacy shutter.

products.name: Shure MV7+

products.shortDescription: Hybrid XLR/USB dynamic microphone with built-in DSP for podcasting.

products.name: Blue Yeti X
products.description: The Blue Yeti X is a professional USB condenser microphone with 4 pickup patterns, a built-in DSP, and a high-res LED meter. It's the go-to microphone for podcasters, streamers, and content creators seeking broadcast-quality sound.
products.shortDescription: USB condenser mic with 4 pickup patterns, built-in DSP.

products.name: Rode PodMic USB
products.description: The Rode PodMic USB is a versatile dynamic microphone with both USB and XLR outputs. Designed for podcasting and streaming, it features an internal pop filter, integrated swing mount adapter, and broadcast-quality audio at an accessible price.
products.shortDescription: Dynamic podcast mic with USB/XLR, internal pop filter.

products.name: Samsung T7 Shield 2TB
products.description: The Samsung T7 Shield 2TB is a rugged portable SSD with IP65 water and dust resistance, drop protection up to 3 meters, and read speeds up to 1050MB/s. It's built for professionals who need reliable, fast storage on the go.
products.shortDescription: 2TB rugged portable SSD, IP65 rated, 1050MB/s read speed.

products.name: WD Black SN850X 1TB NVMe

products.shortDescription: 1TB PCIe Gen 4 NVMe SSD, 7300MB/s read, gaming optimized.

products.name: Crucial X9 Pro 4TB Portable
products.description: The Crucial X9 Pro 4TB portable SSD offers massive storage in a compact, rugged design. With read speeds up to 1050MB/s, IP55 water and dust resistance, and drop protection up to 2 meters, it's perfect for creators handling large video files.
products.shortDescription: 4TB portable SSD, IP55 rated, 1050MB/s, compact design.

specifications.compatibility: Windows, macOS, iPad Pro, Android, Gaming Consoles

products.name: Seagate One Touch 5TB HDD

products.shortDescription: 5TB portable USB 3.0 HDD with backup software, password protection.

products.name: Kingston DataTraveler Max 256GB
products.description: The Kingston DataTraveler Max 256GB is a high-performance USB 3.2 Gen 2 flash drive with read speeds up to 1000MB/s. Its compact design with a keyring loop makes it perfect for carrying large files between workstations.
products.shortDescription: 256GB USB 3.2 Gen 2 flash drive, 1000MB/s read speed.

products.name: CalDigit TS4 Thunderbolt 4 Dock
products.description: The CalDigit TS4 is the ultimate Thunderbolt 4 dock with 18 ports including 3x Thunderbolt 4, 5x USB-A, 2x USB-C, SD card, microSD, 2.5Gb Ethernet, and 98W laptop charging. It transforms any laptop into a powerful desktop workstation.

products.shortDescription: Thunderbolt 4 dock with 11 ports, 96W charging, dual 4K.

products.shortDescription: Thunderbolt 4 dock with premium aluminum design, 96W charging.

products.shortDescription: 13.4-inch OLED ultrabook, Intel Core i7-1360P, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD.

products.name: HP Omen Transcend 32
products.description: A 31.5-inch QD-OLED gaming display with 4K resolution and a blazing 240Hz refresh rate. The HP Omen Transcend 32 delivers 0.03ms response time, VESA DisplayHDR 1000 brightness, and a built-in KVM switch, making it a top choice for gaming and high-end productivity alike.
products.shortDescription: 31.5-inch 4K QD-OLED, 240Hz, 0.03ms, DisplayHDR 1000.

products.name: NuPhy Air75 V2 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard
products.description: Ultra-slim 75% wireless mechanical keyboard with low-profile Gateron switches, PBT keycaps, and tri-mode connectivity. QMK/VIA support lets developers remap every key, while the 2000mAh battery keeps you typing for weeks on a single charge.
products.shortDescription: Slim 75% wireless, hot-swappable, QMK/VIA, 2000mAh battery.

products.name: ASUS ROG Harpe Ace Aim Lab Edition
products.description: An esports-grade wireless mouse co-tuned with Aim Lab. The 36K ROG AimPoint optical sensor tracks flawlessly at 36000 DPI, the 54g shell is barely noticeable, and 4K wireless polling keeps click latency ultra-low.
products.shortDescription: Wireless esports mouse, 36K sensor, 54g, 36000 DPI.

products.name: Sony WH-CH720N Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
products.description: Affordable everyday noise cancelling from Sony. The dual noise sensor system blocks ambient distractions, while the lightweight 192g design and up to 35 hours of battery make these ideal for long commutes, work calls, and travel.
products.shortDescription: Lightweight wireless ANC headphones, 35hr battery, multipoint.

products.name: Roost Stand V3 Adjustable Aluminum Laptop Stand

Its lightweight glass-reinforced nylon and aluminum construction supports a fully customizable ergonomic height, raising your screen to eye level to reduce neck and back strain. It folds flat to pack into a laptop sleeve, making it the ideal travel companion for remote work.

Soft silicone pads hold the laptop firmly while ventilated side slots keep it cool and accessible.

reviews.title: Best laptop for development
reviews.comment: The M3 Pro handles Xcode, Docker, and multiple VS Code windows without breaking a sweat. Battery life is incredible for full-day coding sessions. The display is gorgeous for long hours of work.

reviews.title: Great but pricey
reviews.comment: Incredible build quality and performance. The only reason for 4 stars is the price — it's a significant investment. But for professional development work, it's worth every penny.

reviews.title: Perfect for creators
reviews.comment: The OLED display is stunning for photo and video editing. The RTX 4050 handles Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve smoothly. Build quality is top-notch.

reviews.title: Galaxy AI is a game changer
reviews.comment: The translation and summarization features are incredibly useful. Camera quality is outstanding, especially in low light. The S Pen is still unmatched for note-taking.

reviews.title: Premium Apple experience
reviews.comment: The titanium build feels amazing in hand. USB-C is finally here! The 5x zoom is fantastic for product photography. iOS ecosystem integration is seamless.

reviews.title: Incredible for coding and gaming
reviews.comment: 4K at 160Hz with Nano IPS — what more could you want? Colors are accurate for design work, and the refresh rate is buttery smooth for gaming after work hours.

reviews.title: Best mechanical keyboard I've owned
reviews.comment: The build quality is insane for the price. QMK support means I can customize every key. The Gateron Jupiter switches feel fantastic out of the box. Highly recommend for developers.

reviews.title: Essential for productivity
reviews.comment: The MagSpeed scroll wheel alone is worth the price. Logi Flow lets me switch between my Mac and Windows workstations seamlessly. Ergonomic shape is comfortable for 8+ hours of use.

reviews.title: Perfect noise cancellation
reviews.comment: I use these daily for focus coding in an open office. The ANC blocks out everything. Sound quality is excellent for music and calls. Multi-point connection with phone and laptop works flawlessly.

reviews.title: Podcast quality at home
reviews.comment: The auto-level mode is a lifesaver — no more worrying about mic technique. Sound quality rivals XLR setups at twice the price. The hybrid USB/XLR output gives upgrade flexibility.

reviews.title: Tank-like build quality
reviews.comment: Dropped it from desk height onto concrete and not a scratch. Read speeds are consistently over 1000MB/s. Perfect for backing up projects on the go.

reviews.title: Single cable desktop setup
reviews.comment: One cable to my MacBook Pro and everything just works — dual monitors, ethernet, all peripherals. The 98W charging keeps my laptop topped up. Worth every rupee for the convenience.

reviews.title: Powerful gaming laptop
reviews.comment: Handles every AAA game at high settings. The G14 is impressively light for a gaming laptop. Fan noise is noticeable under load but manageable. Battery life in non-gaming mode is decent.

reviews.title: Solid business laptop
reviews.comment: Keyboard is the best I've ever typed on. TrackPoint is a nice touch for power users. Build quality is exceptional — feels like it could survive anything. Webcam could be better.

reviews.title: Immersive curved display
reviews.comment: 240Hz at 1440p is the sweet spot for gaming. The curve really pulls you in. Colors are vibrant thanks to QLED. Minor backlight bleed in dark scenes but nothing deal-breaking.

reviews.title: Ultimate office keyboard
reviews.comment: Smart illumination that turns on when my hands approach is pure magic. Easy-Switch between my three devices is seamless. Quiet, precise, and beautifully designed.

reviews.title: Great but fit varies
reviews.comment: ANC is excellent for commuting. Sound quality has noticeably improved over AirPods Pro 1. Spatial Audio with head tracking is impressive. Took a star off because the fit isn't perfect for my ears.

reviews.title: Crystal clear video calls
reviews.comment: 4K quality makes me look professional on every call. The adjustable FOV is handy. Windows Hello integration is seamless. Only wish it had a wider FOV option.

reviews.title: Fastest SSD for gaming
reviews.comment: Game load times are virtually eliminated. The 7300MB/s read speed is the real deal. Installed it in my PS5 and it performs flawlessly. WD Dashboard software is useful for monitoring health.

reviews.title: Great value hub
reviews.comment: Does everything I need at a fraction of premium dock prices. 4K@60Hz output is smooth. Gets a bit warm under heavy load but doesn't affect performance. Compact and travel-friendly.

reviews.title: Great value flagship
reviews.comment: 100W charging is incredibly fast — 0 to 100% in under 30 minutes. OxygenOS is clean and snappy. Camera is good but not S24 Ultra level. At this price, it's hard to beat.

reviews.title: RGB masterpiece
reviews.comment: The iCUE control wheel is incredibly useful for quick adjustments. Per-key RGB with LightEdge looks stunning. OPX switches are responsive and satisfying. A bit heavy but worth it.

reviews.title: Worth the upgrade
reviews.comment: Coming from the original Superlight, the improvements are noticeable. LIGHTFORCE switches are clicky yet quiet. 95-hour battery life is no joke. Best gaming mouse on the market.

reviews.title: Massive portable storage
reviews.comment: 4TB in something this small is remarkable. Transfer speeds are consistent. The IP55 rating gives peace of mind. Wish it came with a protective case included.

reviews.title: Developer's dream monitor
reviews.comment: The USB-C 90W PD means one cable to my laptop. KVM switch handles my work and personal machines seamlessly. IPS Black technology makes dark themes look much better than regular IPS.

reviews.title: Versatile podcast mic
reviews.comment: Having 4 pickup patterns is incredibly useful for different recording scenarios. Stereo mode is great for music. Blue VO!CE adds nice polish to voice. Build quality is solid metal.

reviews.title: Beautiful 2-in-1
reviews.comment: The OLED touchscreen is stunning and the 360-degree hinge is smooth. Perfect for presentations and note-taking. Performance is great for everyday tasks. Speakers could be louder.

reviews.title: Camera king
reviews.comment: Night Sight is unbelievable. The clean Android experience is refreshing. 7 years of updates gives incredible longevity. Performance is snappy for daily use and development.

reviews.title: Best ANC I've ever heard
reviews.comment: Immersive Audio is spatial audio done right. Noise cancellation is a noticeable step above the QC45. Comfortable for hours. The carrying case is premium. Absolutely worth the price.

reviews.title: Typing perfection
reviews.comment: The PBT keycaps and steel plate create a satisfying thock sound. Cherry MX Browns are perfectly balanced for typing and light gaming. Compact layout saves desk space without losing functionality.

reviews.title: Good for the price
reviews.comment: 5TB gives plenty of space for backups. Transfer speeds are decent for an HDD. It's not fast like an SSD, but for archival and backups it does the job. A bit bulky to carry around.

reviews.title: Productivity powerhouse
reviews.comment: The 21:9 ratio is amazing for split-screen coding. USB-C with 60W PD means one cable setup. Only downside is 60Hz — would love a higher refresh rate option.
